title: 'Lavender': The AI Machine Directing Israel's Bombing in Gaza
summary: In-depth investigative report based on testimonies from six Israeli intelligence officers detailing the military's reliance on an artificial intelligence machine named 'Lavender' to mark up to 37,000 Palestinian men as suspected targets with minimal human review (often 20 seconds), alongside an automated tracking system named 'Where's Daddy?' designed to strike targets in their family homes, resulting in extensive civilian collateral casualties.
